# West Hollywood College Preparatory School (WHCP)

> A private, nonprofit Pre-K through 12th grade school in West Hollywood, California (Los Angeles area), with small classes, a licensed preschool for ages 2–4, WASC accreditation and year-round enrollment.

- Address: 1317 N. Crescent Heights Blvd., West Hollywood, CA 90046, USA
- Phone: (323) 822-7900 · Fax: (323) 822-7999 · Email: info@westhollywoodschool.com
- Office hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM
- Accreditation: Accrediting Commission for Schools, Western Association of Schools and Colleges (ACS WASC)
- Licensing: Licensed Childcare Center (California Department of Social Services, Community Care Licensing)
- International: SEVP-certified to enroll F-1 students; I-20 support
- Founder and principal: Dr. Elina Dvorskaya. Formerly named Dvorsky College Preparatory School (renamed 2010).
- Academic emphasis: math, language arts and science, with arts at all grade levels

## Programs

- [Early Childhood](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/early-childhood): Pre-school (ages 2–4) and Kindergarten (age 5); play-based, very small groups, Licensed Childcare Center
- [Elementary School](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/elementary): Grades 1–5
- [Middle & High School](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/middle-high): Grades 6–12, college-preparatory, college counseling from 10th grade, SAT/ACT preparation
- [After School](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/after-school): supervised study, enrichment and childcare until 5:00 PM; Summer School, Summer Camp and Saturday School
- [Tutoring Center](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/tutoring): all core subjects and SAT/ACT prep; one-on-one or small groups (2–3)
- [Individual Programs](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/individual): fully customized one-on-one learning, year round
- [International Students](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/international): Grades K–12, ESL, I-20 documentation, dedicated coordinator

## Admissions and tuition (2026–2027)

- [Admissions, tuition and FAQ](https://www.westhollywoodschool.com/admissions): enrollment open year-round
- Monthly tuition: 2 Years–Kindergarten $1,600; Grades 1–5 $1,700; Grades 6–8 $1,900; Grade 9 $2,000; Grades 10–12 $2,300. One-payment annual options and a siblings discount are available.
- International annual tuition: Grades K–5 $18,000; 6–8 $21,000; 9–10 $23,000; 11–12 $25,000
